audit.purpose: Seed for the Source Registry: per-store platform, access policy, and the legitimate live-acquisition route.
audit.method: Public pages only, fetched with a compliant web fetcher (robots.txt honoured, no bypassing). robots.txt, sitemap, one luggage product page, Shopify product JSON + UCP discovery where applicable, terms of use, official/affiliate routes.
limitations: The fetcher converts pages to text and strips <script> tags, so JSON-LD presence is UNCONFIRMED everywhere. A server-side probe must confirm it.
Fetches came from a US cloud IP. Blocking, currency (geo-pricing) and rate limits may differ from our own server.
Terms were read from page text or summaries. This is an engineering assessment, not legal advice.

liveVerificationValues.official_api: Sanctioned machine channel (Shopify UCP/MCP, eBay Browse API, Amazon Creators API).
liveVerificationValues.direct_http: Price readable in the HTML or public JSON with a normal request; robots allows it.
liveVerificationValues.needs_js: Price only appears after JavaScript runs.
liveVerificationValues.blocked: Automated requests get 403 or a challenge.
liveVerificationValues.not_permitted: Terms or robots forbid automated access with no official route.
